captions: Rent on Friday. The bill you keep ignoring.
You refresh the app. The number doesn't change.
You count every euro. You forget who sends it.
14 checks. And still that knot in your chest.
The next morning, the phone stays face down.
You stand on the mat. Two rak'ahs. Slowly.
You hand Him the bills. The rent. The fear.
The number is the same. Your chest is not.

post.caption:
14 times on your bank app this week. 0 minutes on your prayer mat. 💳

Rent. Bills. That knot in your chest. You count every euro — and forget the One who sends it.

“And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him.” (65:3)

Today, before you open that app: two rak'ahs first. 🤲
